title: Google Cloud Composer Failures by Dag
app: Cloud Composer (managed Airflow) logs and metrics via the Google Cloud Add-on / Pub-Sub to HEC.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=gcp:composer state="failed"
| stats count as failures, latest(_time) as last_failure by dag_id
| where failures>0
| sort - failures
description: Counts Google Cloud Composer failures grouped by DAG so operators immediately see which specific DAGs are broken rather than a single global failure number.
value: Object-level failure attribution turns a vague 'Google Cloud Composer is failing' alert into an actionable list of exactly what to fix first.
implementation: Ingest Google Cloud Composer failure events; schedule every 15 minutes and alert on failures for business-critical DAGs.
visualization: Table of DAG by failure count and last failure time.
grandmaExplanation: We tell you exactly which parts of Google Cloud Composer are failing, not just that something is wrong, so the right thing gets fixed first.
